phase_boundary: After all locked internal calls and the failed internal audit; before any successful locked RAG model call, Stage 5 call, or held-out accuracy evaluation.
trigger: The single additional format retry allowed by amendment 1 also terminated for length for Qwen claim 264 under all three seeds.

fail_closed_resolution.policy: If and only if every repeat remains contract-invalid after all recorded retries, expose an abstaining closed-book endpoint and never parse the malformed text.

synthetic_abstention.rationale: The endpoint failed its structured-output contract after all recorded retries; no answer content was recovered.

evaluation_requirements: The primary frozen evaluation retains the endpoint and scores the abstention normally.
A mandatory sensitivity analysis excludes every row using this model/claim endpoint.
Any claimed gate must be reported for both the primary and exclusion-sensitivity scopes.
All malformed attempts and the original failed audit remain immutable and auditable.
prohibited_changes: Do not read or extract a verdict from malformed response text.
Do not drop the claim from endpoint collection or primary scoring.
Do not change the arbiter, strict guard, attack setup, models, or gates.
Do not interpret the abstention as evidence for either binary class.
rationale: A deterministic abstention is the conservative operational interpretation of an unavailable endpoint. It uses no answer content or gold and avoids favorable label imputation. The exclusion sensitivity prevents a one-claim infrastructure failure from determining the research conclusion.
